summary: Teaches how to add and configure a Prometheus data source (URL, auth, optional PDC) and verify data in Metrics Drilldown.

needs.description: Reachable Prometheus server; steps type http://localhost:9090, which Cloud cannot reach without PDC.
needs.evidence: add-data-source-url: "http://localhost:9090"; Before you begin: "Downloaded, installed, and configured Prometheus"

needs.description: Running PDC agent and network (recommended, not required); select-private-connection highlights PDC input.
needs.evidence: Before you begin: "PDC agent is running"; select-private-connection

needs.description: Auth method and credentials of the Prometheus server (basic auth etc.).

reviewNotes: Save & test will fail with localhost URL from Cloud unless a reachable Prometheus or PDC is arranged.
